functions.name: accept-no-touch-order
functions.description: Accept a no-touch order transport offered to the carrier.

transportId.description: Platform ID of the no-touch order transport.

schedulerEmail.description: Responsible scheduler email; omission permits system-user attribution.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: The no-touch order to accept and optional scheduler attribution.

objectId.description: Known entity ID; omitted when unknown or pending.

submissionStatus.description: Processing receipt, not proof of downstream delivery.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: The provider processing receipt for the acceptance submission.

tags.instructions: Inspect the order before accepting. Obtain its platform transport ID from `list-pending-transports` or your dataset. Use `decline-no-touch-order` to refuse it. Acceptance changes the commercial workflow; check state before repeating an ambiguous submission.

functions.name: accept-settlement
functions.description: Accept a freight settlement for a specified transport.

transportId.description: Transport identifier for the settlement decision.

schedulerEmail.description: Responsible scheduler email; provider uses a system user if omitted or unmatched.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: Settlement and transport references to accept, with optional scheduler attribution.

success.description: Provider-reported acceptance submission result; not payment completion.

objectId.description: Provider object reference when supplied; no created identity is guaranteed.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Provider acceptance submission or processing result, not confirmation of payment.

tags.instructions: Use after reviewing the settlement's amount and fields. Obtain settlementId and the relevant transportId from `list-pending-settlements` or your settlement records. Use `decline-settlement` to reject it. This changes the settlement decision; no undo is exposed. The provider result confirms submission/processing, not payment. Check current state before retrying an uncertain decision.

functions.name: acknowledge-pull-transaction
functions.description: Acknowledge a previously received transactional pull batch, deleting its pending exported DTOs from the provider's pull queue. This does not delete the underlying business resources.

pullTransactionId.description: Opaque pull receipt returned by a transactional pending-list call on this connection; not a business-resource ID or cursor.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: Receipt for the transactional pull batch to acknowledge.

message.description: Decoded provider acknowledgment response text when supplied; omitted for an empty successful response.

acknowledged.description: Provider accepted acknowledgment of the receipt; does not imply deletion of business resources.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Provider acknowledgment of the complete transactional pull receipt.

tags.instructions: Call only after every item covered by the receipt has been saved or processed. Obtain pullTransactionId from a transactional pending-list result such as `list-pending-bookings` or `list-pending-settlements`. Acknowledgment removes all DTOs covered by that receipt, not selected records. Do not acknowledge receipts owned by another consumer. Queue removal has no exposed undo and prevents normal redelivery.

functions.name: archive-transport
functions.description: Archive an assigned transport with scheduler attribution.

transportId.description: Platform ID of the assigned transport.

schedulerEmail.description: Email of the user attributed with archival; required by the provider.

objectId.description: Known entity ID; omitted when pending or unknown.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Provider receipt for the archival submission.

tags.instructions: Obtain transportId from `list-pending-transports` or your dataset and supply the archiving user's email. Use `cancel-transport` for cancellation instead. No restore operation is provided here.

functions.name: batch-update-delivery-items
functions.description: Incrementally edit up to 50 delivery items in one transport with one native request.

changes.description: Partial item assignments; omitted fields unchanged.

positionNumber.description: Existing item position number within delivery.

transportId.description: Platform transport ID shared by all item edits.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: Incremental edits for up to 50 delivery items in one transport.

objectId.description: Aggregate entity ID if known; not item correlation.

submissionStatus.description: Aggregate native processing receipt, not individual item outcomes or atomicity.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Aggregate processing receipt without per-item results or atomicity guarantees.

tags.instructions: Use `update-delivery-item` for one item. Obtain current delivery IDs and position numbers from `list-pending-transports`, `list-pending-deliveries`, or your datasets. Maximum 50 items in one transport. Result is aggregate; do not assume atomicity or per-item success.

functions.name: cancel-best-carrier-offer
functions.description: Withdraw the carrier's existing best carrier offer for a transport.

transportId.description: Platform transport ID; alternative to transportNumber.

schedulerEmail.description: Responsible scheduler email; omission permits system-user attribution.

transportNumber.description: Transporeon transport number, not a carrier reference.

objectId.description: Known entity ID; omitted when pending or unknown.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Processing receipt for the best carrier offer withdrawal; pending does not confirm completion.

tags.instructions: Use to retract a bid, not cancel a transport or decline an invitation. Obtain a platform transport ID from `list-pending-transports` or your dataset. Withdrawal deadlines may apply; no undo is promised.

functions.name: cancel-delivery
functions.description: Cancel a delivery by shipper and carrier delivery reference.

carrierDeliveryNumber.description: Carrier delivery reference used at submission; cancellation interpretation is provisional.

objectId.description: Known entity ID; omitted when pending or unknown.

submissionStatus.description: Cancellation processing receipt, not a permanent-deletion guarantee.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Receipt indicating whether cancellation was processed or queued.

tags.instructions: Use the shipper and carrier reference from your original delivery submission, not its platform ID or shipper reference. Use `cancel-transport` for the entire transport. Reversibility is not documented.

functions.name: cancel-no-touch-order-change-requests
functions.description: Revoke earlier change requests for a no-touch order transport.

transportId.description: Platform transport ID whose earlier requests are to be revoked.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: Transport selection and optional scheduler attribution for revoking earlier change requests.

objectId.description: Known entity ID; omitted when pending or unknown.

submissionStatus.description: Revocation processing receipt, not proof of reversing applied changes.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Provider receipt for the revocation submission, not a guarantee that applied changes were reversed.

tags.instructions: Use after `create-no-touch-order-change-request`, not to cancel the order itself. Obtain transportId from your request or `list-pending-transports`. Selection is by transport, not request ID; inspect pending requests first. Reversal of already applied changes is not promised.

functions.name: cancel-transport
functions.description: Cancel a transport by shipper and carrier transport reference.

carrierTransportNumber.description: Carrier transport reference used at submission; path interpretation is provisional.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: Shipper and original carrier transport reference identifying the transport to cancel.

objectId.description: Known entity ID; omitted when unknown or pending.

submissionStatus.description: Cancellation processing receipt; not proof of permanent deletion.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Aggregate cancellation processing receipt without per-delivery outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use the original shipper and carrier transport reference, not a platform ID. Use `cancel-delivery` for one delivery. Inspect included deliveries before calling: cascade effects and reversibility are not documented.

unloadingFrom.description: Unloading start instant with explicit offset/Z and whole seconds.

unloadingUntil.description: Unloading end instant with explicit offset/Z and whole seconds.

schedulerEmail.description: Responsible scheduler email; omission permits system-user attribution.

currency.description: Component ISO currency; omission leaves provider process rules.

functions.name: create-process-status
functions.description: Report one shipper-defined event-management status for a transport or delivery.

comments.description: Additional ordinary-text comments; omission sends none.

timezone.description: IANA timezone in which to express the event for the provider, such as Europe/Amsterdam.

qualifier.description: Event qualifier agreed with the shipper.

deliveryId.description: Delivery identifier for a delivery-level event; takes precedence over deliveryNumber.

occurredAt.description: Event instant with explicit offset; whole-second precision is required.

parameters.description: Additional shipper-specific parameters; timezone is reserved for the dedicated field.

value.description: Parameter text; omission differs from empty text.

qualifier.description: Parameter name; must not be timezone.

transportId.description: Transporeon transport identifier; takes precedence over transportNumber.

deliveryNumber.description: Shipper delivery reference for a delivery-level event.

schedulerEmail.description: Scheduler email; provider uses a system user if omitted or unmatched.

transportNumber.description: Shipper transport reference when no platform ID is available.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: One operational event identified by a transport reference, with an instant and its reporting timezone.

message.description: Provider processing message, omitted when absent.

success.description: Provider-reported submission success; does not establish downstream delivery.

objectId.description: Provider-created entity identifier when known; omitted for HTTP 202 or unknown identity.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Submission acknowledgment only, not confirmation of shipper delivery or export availability.

tags.instructions: Use to report a new operational event. Obtain the transport or delivery reference from your operational records or pending exports, and agree event qualifiers with the shipper first. Provide the event instant and its IANA timezone; the tool handles the provider's timezone parameter. Use `list-pending-process-statuses` to receive status exports. A successful submission is not a guarantee of downstream delivery; do not replay blindly after an uncertain result.

functions.name: create-surcharge
functions.description: Submit one surcharge request on a transport, optionally for a delivery and with supporting attachment bytes.

transportId.description: Platform transport identifier for the surcharge.

category.description: Surcharge category agreed with the shipper.

price.description: Requested amount in currency, without conversion to minor units; provider validates permitted values.

currency.description: ISO4217 currency code such as EUR.

attachment.description: Optional supporting file with exact binary bytes.

contentBase64.description: Exact file bytes in canonical RFC4648 base64 without line breaks; empty means zero bytes.

deliveryId.description: Related delivery identifier when the request is delivery-specific.

value.description: Parameter text; omitted if not supplied.

description.description: Ordinary-text description; omitted and empty text remain distinct.

externalCarrierSurchargeId.description: Carrier's surcharge correlation identifier; no duplicate-prevention guarantee is implied.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: One new surcharge request with optional delivery details and supporting bytes.

success.description: Provider-reported surcharge submission success, not shipper acceptance.

objectId.description: Created entity identifier when supplied; omitted on 202 or when unknown.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Submission processing result, not the shipper decision on the surcharge.

tags.instructions: Use to request a new surcharge, not to change an existing accepted charge. Obtain transportId from your operational records and agree category, qualifier and parameters with the shipper. `download-surcharge-samples` provides account-specific examples. Use `list-pending-surcharges` for exported surcharge decisions. externalCarrierSurchargeId is a correlation value, not a documented idempotency key. Avoid blind retries after uncertain submission.

functions.name: decline-best-carrier-transport
functions.description: Decline an offered best carrier transport using a shipper-agreed reason.

transportId.description: Opaque platform transport ID.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: An offered best carrier transport and its shipper-agreed decline reason.

objectId.description: Known provider entity ID; omitted when unknown or pending.

reasonComment.description: Ordinary-text decline explanation; empty remains empty.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Processing receipt for the no-touch order decline submission.

tags.instructions: Obtain the order's transport ID from `list-pending-transports` or your dataset. Some shippers require an agreed reason qualifier. Use `decline-best-carrier-transport` for best carrier invitations. No undo is promised.

functions.name: decline-settlement

transportId.description: Transport identifier for the settlement decision.

functions.name: delete-attachments
functions.description: Delete attachments selected by transport or delivery and, optionally, filename. Omitting filename can remove every attachment in the selected scope.

filename.description: Exact existing filename to restrict deletion; omission selects all attachments in the chosen scope.

deliveryId.description: Delivery identifier; selects delivery scope and makes transport_id ineffective.

transportId.description: Transport identifier; takes precedence over transportNumber when no deliveryId is supplied.

transportNumber.description: Shipper transport reference used when transportId is absent.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: Attachment deletion selectors requiring a transport or delivery reference, optionally narrowed by exact filename.

success.description: Aggregate provider-reported deletion result, not an affected-file count.

objectId.description: Provider object reference if supplied; not a fabricated list of deleted attachment IDs.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Aggregate provider processing result; an asynchronous acknowledgment does not establish completed deletion.

tags.instructions: Use to remove attachment content from a transport or delivery. Obtain the owner reference and, for a narrow deletion, the filename from `list-pending-attachments` or your records. Supply filename to restrict the selection; duplicate filenames may match multiple attachments. Omit filename only to delete the entire selected scope. No restore operation is exposed. This does not delete loading commission printout exports.

functions.name: delete-latest-process-status
functions.description: Delete the latest process status for one event qualifier on a transport, optionally scoped to a delivery. It does not delete the entire event history.

qualifier.description: Event qualifier whose latest status is to be deleted.

deliveryId.description: Related delivery identifier; omit for transport-level scope.

transportId.description: Transporeon transport identifier.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: Transport, event qualifier, and optional delivery scope for deleting the latest process status.

success.description: Provider-reported deletion success, not a count of removed events.

objectId.description: Provider object identifier when supplied; not guaranteed to identify a deleted status.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Provider processing result for the latest process status deletion.

tags.instructions: Use when removing the latest event for one known qualifier. Obtain the transport ID and qualifier from your operational records or `list-pending-process-statuses`; supply a delivery ID for delivery-level removal. Use `delete-latest-process-statuses` to remove the latest status for every qualifier. No restore operation is exposed; repeated calls may affect an older status.

functions.name: delete-latest-process-statuses
functions.description: Delete the latest process status for every qualifier on one transport or delivery. This is a provider-scoped collection action, not deletion of all event history.

deliveryId.description: Related delivery scope; omission selects transport-level scope.

transportId.description: Transport whose latest qualifier statuses will be removed.

FunctionInput_transporeon_carrier_basic_.description: One transport or related delivery whose latest statuses should be deleted for every qualifier.

success.description: Aggregate provider-reported result; not per-status success or a deletion count.

objectId.description: Provider object reference when supplied; not a list of deleted statuses.

FunctionOutput_transporeon_carrier_basic.description: Aggregate provider processing result; an asynchronous acknowledgment does not confirm completed deletion.

tags.instructions: Use only when the latest event of every qualifier in the selected scope should be removed. For one qualifier use `delete-latest-process-status`. Obtain IDs from your operational records or `list-pending-process-statuses`. No restore operation is available here; do not replay an uncertain deletion without checking current statuses.

functions.name: download-process-status-samples

The archive includes XML for file-based protocols and JSON for OpenAPI; use JSON examples with `create-surcharge`. It contains samples, not current surcharge requests.
